findings.summary: KWIML version.h not generated in Bazel: KWIML_VERSION_DECIMAL and KWIML_VERSION substitutions are absent
findings.evidence: CMake configure_file(src/version.h.in include/kwiml/version.h @ONLY) substitutes @KWIML_VERSION_DECIMAL@ and @KWIML_VERSION@; Bazel BUILD.bazel lists vtkkwiml/include/kwiml/abi.h and int.h as hdrs but has no write_file rule for version.h, so consumers that include <kwiml/version.h> fall through to any pre-committed stub, silently reporting wrong version numbers

findings.summary: VTK_USE_64BIT_IDS baked as enabled in Bazel, overriding the CMake platform-default option
findings.evidence: CMake: option(VTK_USE_64BIT_IDS ... "${vtk_use_64bit_ids_default}") is user-configurable and on 32-bit platforms defaults to OFF; Bazel generates #define VTK_USE_64BIT_IDS unconditionally in vtkConfigure.h write_file — builds silently assume 64-bit IDs regardless of target architecture or user preference

findings.summary: vtktoken cc_library uses linkstatic=True but CMake explicitly declares it SHARED
findings.evidence: CMake: add_library(token SHARED ${sources} ${headers}) at line 51 — the library is explicitly SHARED so that a single token-registry instance is shared across plugin boundaries; Bazel BUILD: linkstatic = True  # keep, overriding this intent. Programs that load VTK as plugins or use Python wrapping will silently get duplicate registries.

findings.summary: vtkTestSocketFeatures.cmake feature detection baked in as defined; portability to non-POSIX or older UNIX hosts is silently lost
findings.evidence: CMake vtkTestSocketFeatures.cmake:12-41 uses try_compile and check_symbol_exists to probe VTK_HAVE_GETSOCKNAME_WITH_SOCKLEN_T and VTK_HAVE_SO_REUSEADDR at configure time; Bazel Common/System BUILD write_file unconditionally emits #define VTK_HAVE_GETSOCKNAME_WITH_SOCKLEN_T and #define VTK_HAVE_SO_REUSEADDR — a host that lacks socklen_t overloads (e.g., very old glibc or embedded POSIX) silently gets wrong function signatures

findings.summary: FreeType always compiles builds/unix/ftsystem.c; Windows target would silently get the wrong platform source
findings.evidence: CMake: if(UNIX) list(APPEND sources builds/unix/ftsystem.c) / if(WIN32) list(APPEND sources src/base/ftsystem.c) — the two platform variants do meaningfully different I/O; Bazel hardcodes builds/unix/ftsystem.c with no select() guard, so a Windows cross-compile silently links the POSIX file-system backend

findings.summary: JSONCPP JSON_DLL always undef'd in Bazel; shared-library Windows builds silently miss DLL export symbols
findings.evidence: CMake: if(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS) set(JSON_DLL 1) then configure_file generates vtkjsoncpp_config.h with #define JSON_DLL; Bazel write_file hardcodes /* #undef JSON_DLL */ unconditionally — a Windows DLL build would compile without the dllexport/dllimport annotations and produce incorrect import-lib linkage

findings.summary: SMP backend is permanently locked to Sequential+STDThread; TBB and OpenMP sources are never compiled
findings.evidence: CMake: option VTK_SMP_IMPLEMENTATION_TYPE defaults to Sequential but is user-configurable to TBB or OpenMP, and conditionally compiles SMP/TBB/ and SMP/OpenMP/ sources; Bazel Common/Core BUILD hardcodes VTK_SMP_ENABLE_TBB 0 / VTK_SMP_ENABLE_OPENMP 0 and omits SMP/OpenMP/vtkSMPToolsImpl.cxx from srcs — switching backends requires modifying generated BUILD files

findings.summary: VTK_DISPATCH_SOA_ARRAYS and VTK_DISPATCH_TYPED_ARRAYS defaults are baked; non-default dispatcher configurations are impossible without editing generated files
findings.evidence: CMake: option(VTK_DISPATCH_SOA_ARRAYS ... OFF), option(VTK_DISPATCH_TYPED_ARRAYS ... OFF) etc. are user-toggleable and drive vtkCreateArrayDispatchArrayList.cmake which regenerates vtkArrayDispatchArrayList.h; Bazel write_file hardcodes the array-list with only AOS types — users who need SOA dispatch for memory-layout-sensitive workloads must hand-edit the generated BUILD

findings.summary: PNG library missing libm link dependency on UNIX; math symbols may be unresolved on systems that do not auto-link libm
findings.evidence: CMake: if(UNIX) target_link_libraries(png PRIVATE m) links libm explicitly; Bazel BUILD png cc_library deps list does not include a system math library entry — on glibc systems this is often satisfied transitively but on musl libc or some embedded targets the floor/ceil/pow calls from libpng will produce undefined-symbol link errors
